listing.title: My First Weather & Nature Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Weather and Nature Pages – Sun, Rainbow, Snowman, Tree & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly weather and nature pictures!

Little hands color 30 cute pages of sunny, rainy and snowy days and the outdoors, from a smiling sun and a rain cloud to a rainbow, a snowman, a pine tree and a dandelion. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Sunny, cloudy and rainy days: Sun, Cloud, Sun and Cloud, Rain Cloud, Raindrop, Storm Cloud, Rainbow, Wind and Puddle
  • Snowy days: Snowflake, Snowman, Mittens, Winter Hat and Sled
  • What to wear outside: Rain Boots, Raincoat and Sunglasses
  • Out in nature: Tree, Pine Tree, Bush, Sprout, Clover, Dandelion, Cactus, Acorn, Maple Leaf, Tree Stump, Rock, Mountain and Pond
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
